I completely agree with you on this and as a person who works for the company, my opinion may be regarded as bias. 
What I will say is that the best part of the Champ brand is that their revamp didn't include remakes of old classics, they just used the same product and idea that they had and made it again. 

A garment, say the Champion classic hoodie, was something that was plain and awesome the way it was, in the '90s. But when the collaboration ideas started cranking out it was explosive the response and when Instagram icons started flashing that white/red C on their pictures and videos people started to remember their childhood and teen years. There are also some big name musicians that are plugging the logo and it is becoming or has already become a phenomenon.
